$comment: Wet barks (docs/ai-layer.md [neighbourhood-barks], the wave-2 hundred): what a standing adult says when the player's stream wets them. Annoyance only, never distress; plain English, no accent spelling, no ethnicity. Children, seated or lying people, mobility-aid users and animals never get wet, so they never say these.

provenance.review: Pending: a second agent session reads every line against the checklist in docs/ai-layer.md, then the user reviews a stratified 10% sample.

barks.speaker: commuter
barks.text: Hey! I'm not a robot!

barks.speaker: commuter
barks.text: Really? I'm on my way to a meeting.

barks.speaker: commuter
barks.text: This is a dry-clean-only jacket. Was.

barks.speaker: commuter
barks.text: Water. On my commute. Great.

barks.speaker: commuter
barks.text: Do I look rust-prone to you?

barks.speaker: commuter
barks.text: I have a call in five minutes and now I have a call in a towel.

barks.speaker: commuter
barks.text: Watch where you point that thing!

barks.speaker: commuter
barks.text: My laptop bag is now a laptop pond.

barks.speaker: commuter
barks.text: I'm sending you my dry-cleaning bill.

barks.speaker: commuter
barks.text: That's one way to start a Tuesday.

barks.speaker: commuter
barks.text: I was having a perfectly dry morning.

barks.speaker: commuter
barks.text: Excuse me, I'm a person. With socks. Wet socks.

barks.speaker: commuter
barks.text: Is this a new kind of networking event?

barks.speaker: commuter
barks.text: My train ticket is soggy. Thanks.

barks.speaker: commuter
barks.text: Seriously? I just dried off from the fog.

barks.speaker: commuter
barks.text: I'm going to be the damp one in the meeting now.

barks.speaker: commuter
barks.text: Point it at the robots! The robots!

barks.speaker: commuter
barks.text: Wow. Okay. Wow.

barks.speaker: commuter
barks.text: Do you have a towel? You owe me a towel.

barks.speaker: commuter
barks.text: I can't believe this was the wettest part of my day.

barks.speaker: techWorker
barks.text: Cool. I'll file a bug.

barks.speaker: techWorker
barks.text: Did you just A/B test me with a hose?

barks.speaker: techWorker
barks.text: This hoodie is not water-resistant. It's water-aware now.

barks.speaker: techWorker
barks.text: Love the energy. Hate the moisture.

barks.speaker: techWorker
barks.text: My badge still works, right? Right?

barks.speaker: techWorker
barks.text: That's not a feature. That's a regression.

barks.speaker: techWorker
barks.text: I'm not the bad robot. I'm a product manager.

barks.speaker: techWorker
barks.text: Great, now my fleece is a sponge.

barks.speaker: techWorker
barks.text: Please add a confirmation dialog to that thing.

barks.speaker: techWorker
barks.text: You just soaked my keynote notes.

barks.speaker: techWorker
barks.text: Should've shipped a splash seal for people.

barks.speaker: techWorker
barks.text: That's going in the retro.

barks.speaker: techWorker
barks.text: My laptop survived a launch. It may not survive you.

barks.speaker: techWorker
barks.text: I wasn't even standing near a robot. I was standing near a latte.

barks.speaker: techWorker
barks.text: Strong opinions, loosely aimed.

barks.speaker: techWorker
barks.text: Okay, who's scoping your aim? We need to talk.

barks.speaker: techWorker
barks.text: I'm going to need a minute. And a dryer.

barks.speaker: techWorker
barks.text: That is not how you onboard someone.

barks.speaker: techWorker
barks.text: My standup is in ten minutes. I'm a sitdown now.

barks.speaker: techWorker
barks.text: I see you've chosen chaos as your stack.

barks.speaker: tourist
barks.text: Is this part of the tour?

barks.speaker: tourist
barks.text: Nobody told me San Francisco had a splash zone.

barks.speaker: tourist
barks.text: My map is soaked. Where am I?

barks.speaker: tourist
barks.text: I came for the fog, not the hose.

barks.speaker: tourist
barks.text: Hey! I just bought this sweatshirt!

barks.speaker: tourist
barks.text: Is this a local custom? It's not a good one.

barks.speaker: tourist
barks.text: I paid for the cable car, not the car wash.

barks.speaker: tourist
barks.text: Okay, that's going in my review.

barks.speaker: tourist
barks.text: Excuse me, which way to somewhere dry?

barks.speaker: tourist
barks.text: The guidebook said layers. It did not say this.

barks.speaker: tourist
barks.text: My camera! It's fine. I'm fine. We're fine.

barks.speaker: tourist
barks.text: So that's why everyone wears jackets here.

barks.speaker: tourist
barks.text: I think I'm the wettest tourist on this street.

barks.speaker: tourist
barks.text: Was that on purpose? Don't answer that.

barks.speaker: tourist
barks.text: I wanted a souvenir, not a soaking.

barks.speaker: tourist
barks.text: At least the sourdough is still dry.

barks.speaker: tourist
barks.text: Ha. Very funny. Very wet.

barks.speaker: tourist
barks.text: Now I know what the robots feel like.

barks.speaker: tourist
barks.text: This is the most local thing that's happened to me.

barks.speaker: tourist
barks.text: I'm writing a postcard about this, and it's going to be soggy.

barks.speaker: local
barks.text: Every week. Every single week.

barks.speaker: local
barks.text: I live here. I'm already damp from the fog.

barks.speaker: local
barks.text: You missed the robot by three metres and me by zero.

barks.speaker: local
barks.text: Thanks. My plants were jealous of the rain.

barks.speaker: local
barks.text: I was waiting for the bus. Now I'm waiting for the bus, wet.

barks.speaker: local
barks.text: This is a hat, not a target.

barks.speaker: local
barks.text: Ah yes. The famous San Francisco summer.

barks.speaker: local
barks.text: I'll add it to the list of things that happened today.

barks.speaker: local
barks.text: Next time, aim with your eyes open.

barks.speaker: local
barks.text: My groceries are fine. I'm the one who's soaked.

barks.speaker: local
barks.text: Nice stream. Wrong audience.

barks.speaker: local
barks.text: I've been rained on, fogged on, and now this.

barks.speaker: local
barks.text: Could you not? Thank you.

barks.speaker: local
barks.text: I'm going home to change. Again.

barks.speaker: local
barks.text: Wet again. Classic.

barks.speaker: local
barks.text: Do you know how long it takes jeans to dry here? Days.

barks.speaker: local
barks.text: You're lucky I like this neighbourhood.

barks.speaker: local
barks.text: My dog walker's going to laugh at me.

barks.speaker: local
barks.text: Bold choice, spraying the one person on the block.

barks.speaker: local
barks.text: Sure. Why not. Hose the neighbour.

barks.text: The awning was supposed to keep me dry.

barks.speaker: vendor
barks.text: That's my till! Okay, it's fine. It's waterproof. Mostly.

barks.text: I sell coffee, not iced coffee!

barks.speaker: vendor
barks.text: Now my apron's soaked. Please buy something.

barks.speaker: vendor
barks.text: You owe me a squeegee.

barks.speaker: vendor
barks.text: I'm going to need a minute behind the counter.

barks.text: Was that for me or the robot? Either way, stop.

barks.speaker: vendor
barks.text: Dripping on the receipts. Wonderful.

barks.speaker: vendor
barks.text: Okay. Okay. Deep breath. Wet breath.

barks.speaker: vendor
barks.text: Can you aim at something that rusts, please?

barks.speaker: vendor
barks.text: I have a business to run and now it's a damp one.

barks.speaker: vendor
barks.text: That's coming out of your next order.

barks.speaker: vendor
barks.text: I'll be wiping this window till noon.

barks.speaker: vendor
barks.text: Do I look like I need a rinse?
